description: This file defines the interface for progress reporting in a version control system, including function declarations for starting, stopping, and displaying progress, along with conditional testing variables.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays the throughput of the progress operation.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a progress indicator.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a sparse progress indicator.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a delayed sparse progress indicator.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops progress display with a custom message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Stops progress display with default 'done' message.
